verdict.rationale: Docs clearly describe fine-tuning supported base models via LoRA or full fine-tuning, launched via console/API/CLI, with Together AI handling the full lifecycle including hosting and inference on a dedicated endpoint (same platform), and dedicated-endpoint docs explicitly list 'Fine-tuned models: Deploy a model you fine-tuned from a supported base model.' Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end fine-tune-then-serve workflow and concrete benchmarks/success reports from third parties.
